note:
Two faults fixed in one frame: the charcoal knit top is gone with no clothing in view, and the label is no longer garbled.

WHY THE LABEL WAS WRONG, AND WHY IT IS RIGHT NOW. The shipped hero was generated by Seedream at 3072px, which left the label about 360px wide and the smallest line about 12px of cap height — below what any engine can set, so 'PREMIUM FORMULA' came out as mush and '2% GHK-CU | 30ML' as '0M-0J | 5IM'. This frame was generated by Nano Banana Pro at 6336px, where the same label gets about 580px and the letters are formed correctly before anything is downscaled. The fix was resolution at the moment of generation, not sharpening afterwards; no downstream filter could have recovered the original.

COMPOSITION IS UNCHANGED, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. The subject's left edge sits at 34.7% of frame width in the shipped hero and at 34.7% in this one. The 300px of width trimmed to reach the hero's 2.246:1 aspect was therefore split unevenly, 104px from the left and 196px from the right, specifically to hold that number — a symmetric crop would have drifted the subject and moved the headline's clear zone.

KNOWN REMAINING FLAW, ACCEPTED. Her thumb clips the leading '2' of '2% GHK-CU | 30ML', so that line reads '% GHK-CU | 30ML'. Every candidate on this route does the same, because the hand position is inherited from the frame being edited. It is legible and correct rather than garbled, and at the hero's rendered width that line is a few pixels tall either way. Flagged to Malcolm; re-runnable with the hand moved lower if he wants it clean.

NEW FILENAME, NOT A RE-UPLOAD — see no-knitwear-publish.json for the reasoning. The original hero file stays in Files, untouched and unreferenced.

TWO SLOTS, NOT ONE — found by reading the live template back rather than trusting the plan. skingenetix-hero-model-copper-peptide-2026.jpg was referenced by hero_slide_1 as well as hero_slide_3, so the same sweater-and-garbled-label photograph was carrying two of the three hero slides. Malcolm named the image, not the slot, so both are repointed at v2. The duplication itself is pre-existing and is left alone here: slide 1 runs the copper peptide product copy and slide 3 the brand copy, and choosing a different photograph for one of them is a design decision, not part of this fix.
